facts.fact: Static mode fixes state count to1 and disables count, monitor, interval and condition group.
Time mode count defaults2, range2..128. Interval defaults1, range1..1000, unit100ms. Monitor disabled.
Numeric mode defaults addressLW0, enables monitor and state count2..128, disables interval.
Bit mode defaults addressLB0, enables monitor, forces exactly2 states and disables count/interval.
Count3→bit→time leaves2; multiple→static fixes1. Disabled draft monitor text can remainLB0.
State list is DropWidget,2 columns. Shrinking3→2 then regrowing3 discards state2 image; delete clears selected image and preserves row count/state number.
Batch enabled with3 states: start0,end1, both min0/max2.
Explicit gallery column1 selection identifies probe-green.png. Distinct states red/green swap to green/red on Down and return on Up.
Gallery cancel preserves selected row; child confirm followed by parent cancel restores original rows; source checkpoint hashes equal original.
PNG static import and two-state distinct red/green native save and offline compile succeeded. Compiled type15, ControlPara640B.

limitations: Full .sm body and device picture resource codec remain unresolved.
No hardware rendering or monitor timing has been tested. Numeric/bit variant samples contain two red references; distinct-r1 is the verified red/green sample.
Multiple-r2 table label two-images-red-green is inaccurate: both rows were actually probe-red.png. Table contents are authoritative.
Batch add/delete execution, drag/drop, invalid-file/format bounds, resource replacement/deletion and every permission combination are not covered.
Gallery import followed by cancel appeared discarded in load-r1; retained partial run is insufficient to claim complete library resource transaction semantics.
scope: Native W1 host evidence; no W2 physical panel runtime or source/device codec compatibility claimed.

supplements.scope: W1 native picture list batch operations, using real saved three-state red/green/green source and existing two PNG gallery resources.

facts.fact: Reopened native three-state source initializes batch start0/end2. An in-session increase from2 to3 had retained end1 in earlier lifecycle evidence; the end draft is not always reset to count-1.
Batch Add and Batch Delete checkboxes are independent, both can be true. Shared range enabled equals logical OR; unchecking one while the other stays true retains enabled range.
Checking Batch Delete does not clear any image immediately. Clicking Delete Current State Picture clears the closed range and retains rows/state numbers.
Batch Delete equal range1..1 clears only state1. Reversed2..0 leaves rows unchanged; no error dialog was captured in that probe.
With3 states, range spinboxes min0/max2. Native setValue(-10) and setValue(999) clamp to0 and2. Valid last-state range2..2 works.
Batch Add range0..1 with one selected red image fills only state0, leaving state1 empty. It neither repeats the image nor automatically takes the next gallery image.

Batch Add gallery uses MultiSelection(mode2). Clicking green then red produces native selectedItems [(0,1),(0,0)], yet confirm fills red then green in states0/1: gallery position order governs this two-item probe, not click order.
Two selected images fill only two rows of range0..2; trailing state2 remains empty. Equal range1..1 truncates two selected images to red at state1; state2 remains empty.
With both checkboxes true, the gallery still performs batch add and Delete Current State Picture performs batch delete using the shared range.
Batch Add reversed2..0 rejects before opening gallery with 批量加起始结束位置异常，请重新设置。 and leaves list unchanged.

limitations: Tests cover the existing two PNG resources in engineer/project gallery. System gallery, cross-row ordering across more than5 assets, duplicate resource names and asset import bulk dialog were not exercised.
This supplement does not restore .sm source body, binary resource encoding, W2 panel switching or file/resource global transactions.
batch-add-r1 completed single/equal/boundary observations but later failed looking for a gallery after reversed range rejection. batch-multi-r2 captured the actual rejection message.

batch-multi-flags-r1 completed checkbox truth table but failed the initial selectedItems getter because Qt4 exports this method as nonconst. Native DLL export was checked, getter corrected, and batch-multi-r2 succeeded.
supplements.supersededInitialLimitation: The initial findings limitation about uncovered batch add/delete execution is narrowed by these observed cases; other initial gaps remain.
